summary: A Georgia list places a tift tower in Tift County; a 2014 Commons photo titled as a Georgia Forestry Commission tower on US 41 N lies close to its coordinates, matched by camera position only; no history found.

notes_for_editor: The photo matches the tift record by camera position only, well under 100 m by my own estimate; no sign or plaque is described. A separate list entry 'tifton' (GA207, 31.49091, -83.43880, elevation 364) lies about 8 km east in the same county; a human should check whether it is a second tower or a duplicate. No NHLR, FFLOS or FFLA page for this tower was found. The record status is unknown and no source after 2014 was found.
